title: VERY LOUD FAHHH
blurb: Consider this the nuclear option, and consider yourself warned. The fahhh scream is meme culture's purest expression of shock, and this edition removes the volume ceiling entirely — clipped, distorted and mastered with open hostility towards anyone wearing headphones. It routinely tops the play counts on entire soundboards for exactly that reason: half the people clicking it are testing it on somebody else. Best deployed for jump scares, sudden realisations, and the destruction of anyone who trusted you with an unmuted mic. There is no polite way to use it, which is precisely the appeal.
origin: The maximum-volume edition of the viral 'fahh' scream.
